## Change / 修改内容

Describe what changed and why. Link a related issue if there is one; an issue is not required before a PR.
说明修改内容与原因；如有相关 Issue 请附链接，无需先开 Issue 才能提交 PR。

## Applicable checks / 适用检查

Keep only the items relevant to this change, or mark them N/A with a reason. Check only work actually completed. English or Chinese submissions are welcome; note translation or review help needed below.
仅保留适用项，或注明不适用及原因。只勾选实际完成的检查。中英文任选一种提交，需要翻译或审核帮助请在下方说明。

- [ ] Resource addition/change: primary sources support the purpose, use case and material constraints; costs and dependencies are accurate. / 新增或修改资源：原始来源支持用途、场景和必要条件，费用与依赖准确。
- [ ] Self-recommendation or related resource: relationship to the author or product is disclosed. / 自荐或关联资源：已说明与作者或产品的关系。
- [ ] Theme/image change: source, credit, usage rights and descriptive alt text are included. / 主题或图片修改：已提供来源、署名、使用许可及替代文本。
- [ ] Catalog/navigation change: affected language versions, groups and related links agree; generated Markdown is included. / 目录或导航修改：相关双语内容、分类和关联链接一致，已包含生成的 Markdown。
- [ ] Code/build change: relevant tests and build checks have been run. / 代码或构建修改：已运行相关测试和构建检查。

## Validation and help needed / 验证与需要的帮助

List checks run and results; explicitly note checks not run and why. For a typo-only change, reading the affected text may be sufficient. Maintainers complete applicable checks and bilingual review before merging.
列出已运行的检查及结果，未运行的检查请注明原因。仅修正错字时，可只核对受影响文字。维护者在合并前补齐适用检查和双语审核。
